privacy.title: Kokoam Nhyehyɛe
privacy.s1Body: Great Sport Bets boaboa nsɛm kakraa bi a ɛfa wo ankasa ho a ɛsɛ hɔ ma akontaabu bue ne Premium access, a email addresses ne payment details a Stripe (web) ne Google Play / RevenueCat (Android) di so yɛ no ahobammɔ mu.
privacy.s2Body: Yɛde wo nsɛm ma wo nya yɛn betting tips, yɛ payment, na yɛhwɛ referral system so. Yɛntɔn wo ankasa nsɛm mma nnipa foforo.
privacy.s3Body: Yɛde Supabase, Stripe, Google Play ne RevenueCat di ahobammɔ ho dwuma a ɛyɛ industry standard de bɔ wo data ho ban. Nanso, ɛnyɛ kwan biara a wɔfa so soma nsɛm wɔ Internet so na ɛyɛ 100% ahobammɔ.
privacy.s4Body: Sɛ wowɔ nsɛmmisa biara fa yɛn Kokoamsɛm Ho Mmara yi ho a, kɔntakt yɛn wɔ greatsportbets@gmail.com.

terms.title: Mmara a Ɛfa Ɔsom Ho
terms.s1Body: Great Sport Bets de nsɛm a ɛfa betting tips ne surebets ho ma. Yɛnnyɛ gambling som anaa sikasɛm afotu. Akɔntabɔ biara a wobɛbɔ no, wo ara na wogye ho asodi.
terms.s2Body: Wonya Premium denam subscription a ɛwɔ Android so (Google Play, a RevenueCat na ɛhwɛ so) ne ntɔ a wotɔ pɛnkoro wɔ wɛb so (a Stripe na ɛhwɛ so). Google Play subscriptions no gyina Google Play ne sika ntua ne sika a wɔsan tua mmara so. Wɛb so ntɔ no di mũ bere a wɔama wo kwan no.
terms.s3Body: Wɔyɛɛ yɛn referral nhyehyɛe yi ma ɛyɛ wo ankasa dwuma. Sɛ wɔde di bɔne—sɛ wo ankasa referral anaa account a wɔbɔ wia—a, wɔbɛsusu wo account na woahwere bonuses.
terms.s4Body: Great Sport Bets nnhyɛ nkɔm sɛ wobɛnya nkonya. Nneɛma a atwam no nkyerɛ nea ɛbɛba daakye. Bɔ akɔntabɔ berɛ biara wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so.

deletion.intro: Wɔ Great Sport Bets, yɛbu wo kokoamsɛm na yɛama kwan a ɛda adi pefee sɛ wobɛpepa wo account ne wo data.

deletion.warningBody: Sɛ wopepa wo account a, ɛntumi nsakyera. Wobɛhwere kwan a wobɛfa akɔ wo Premium status, referral bonuses, ne abakɔsɛm. Saa dwuma yi ntumi nteɛ.
deletion.step1: Soma email kɔ <email>{{email}}</email> fi email address a ɛka wo Great Sport Bets account ho no so.
deletion.step2: Fa "Account Deletion Request" hyɛ subject line no mu.
deletion.step3: Wobɛhwɛ wo abisade no mu wɔ adwuma nna 7 mu. Wobɛnya email a ɛbɛsi so dua sɛ wɔapepa no wie.
deletion.deleted2: Premium access records ne sika ntua abakɔsɛm
deletion.keptBody: Esiane mmara ne sikasɛm ho nsɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ so nti (te sɛ tax reporting ma Stripe ne Google Play ntua), yɛbɛkora transaction IDs ne metadata so mfe 5. Saa data yi ntɔ wo ankasa identity ho, na wɔde di dwuma kɛkɛ ma auditing.
